capabilities: Sync Scriben meeting recordings into the vault as markdown notes with frontmatter, summary and action items
Run sync on Obsidian open, on a schedule, or from a ribbon button
Share selected folders' notes back to Scriben for context in its answers
Preserve user-written content outside the managed marker region on re-sync
Connect and disconnect a vault via an approval code
extras: Sharing folders back to Scriben is off by default and empty by default; the plugin sends no telemetry and only talks to app.scriben.ai. Requires Obsidian 1.4.0+; desktop and mobile both supported.
motivation: The README says the plugin 'puts that in the vault you already keep', so meeting notes land where users already write.
problem: Meeting transcripts, summaries and action items captured with Scriben live outside the vault, so users must copy them in by hand.

relations.evidence: The plugin talks to app.scriben.ai and nothing else, and only when you have connected it.

summary: Sync plugin that pulls Scriben meeting notes into the vault as markdown and optionally shares chosen folders back to Scriben.
